body:

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `5b14b7f3ad8e2e0786d228772f473d07b36b2477` (objectstack-ai/objectstack main), working tree clean
- console: `.objectui-sha` = `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`, built with `pnpm objectui:build`; `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` stamp equals the pin (`pnpm check:console-sha` green), so the stale-console-bundle trap is ruled out for every console observation

- Tier 1 pins: vitest per package against the same tree (`pnpm exec vitest run FILES`), 97 framework files / 2209 tests, 0 failed; objectui-side pins run inside a clone of objectui at `4016370af3c9` (unit vitest + `playwright.live.config.ts` against a showcase boot on :47431 through the objectui console dev server), RUNNER option (b)
- browser: Playwright with `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, own context per persona, sign-in through the form
- timestamps: 2026-10-19, environment prep 12:26–12:43 UTC, testing 12:43–13:53 UTC; Tier 2 items were driven in parallel by sub-runners (≤ 3–4 browser items at once), each on its own port/DB
